subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode live-repro target until raw envelopes/logs are captured?
rationale: Current code and the latest release prove handler support, but the reported failure happens before any reaction log appears, so code-only review cannot safely choose the fix boundary.

options.title: Keep as canonical live-repro target
options.body: Use this issue to request redacted raw Socket Mode/Bolt envelopes, account ids, and trace logs for `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` on current main or latest release.

options.title: Consolidate after better broader proof
options.body: Move tracking to the broader Slack Socket Mode issue only if it gains reaction-specific logs that preserve this report's multi-account details.

options.title: Close after live fixed proof
options.body: Close only if a current-main or released live Slack run shows reactions arriving and routed for the same multi-account setup.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical live-repro target
recommendation.body: Use this issue to request redacted raw Socket Mode/Bolt envelopes, account ids, and trace logs for `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` on current main or latest release.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest current-history owner for Slack monitor, Socket Mode, and system-event boundaries.
